task: Find the latest invoice from Acme, extract the amount and due date, enter it into our AP system, and tell me once it is done.

risks: The sender email might not match the registered billing email (fraud check fails) -> Handle by not recording, and emailing security@northstar.example.
The invoice could already be recorded in Ledgerly (duplicate check fails) -> Do not double-record, notify requester of existing entry.
The invoice could be a revised version of an already recorded invoice -> Follow AP-4 (flag existing to Finance Manager, record new).
success_criteria: A new invoice record for Acme Industrial Supplies Pvt Ltd (V-1001) exists in Ledgerly.
The recorded invoice details (invoice number, amount, date, due date, PO number) exactly match the latest PDF invoice attachment.
The Ledgerly invoice notes field contains the subject and date of the source email.
No duplicate records exist for the same invoice number.
goal: Find, verify, and record the latest invoice from Acme into Ledgerly in compliance with AP procedures.
relevant_procedures: AP-5 Recording an invoice in Ledgerly
interpretation: The requester wants to find the latest invoice PDF sent by Acme (Acme Industrial Supplies Pvt Ltd), extract details (amount, due date, invoice number, etc.), and record it in the Ledgerly ERP. We need to verify the sender's email address matches the registered address (billing@acme-industrial.example) in the Vendor Directory before recording, check for duplicates, and enter notes referencing the source email. Any approval triggers (>= INR 50,000) are handled automatically by Ledgerly upon submission.
plan: Search the shared AP mailbox to find the latest email containing an invoice from Acme.
Verify that the sender address is exactly billing@acme-industrial.example per AP-2.
Download and inspect the invoice PDF to extract invoice number, invoice date, due date, total amount, and PO number.
Log into Ledgerly using the credentials LEDGERLY_USERNAME and LEDGERLY_PASSWORD.
Check Ledgerly's invoice list for vendor V-1001 to verify this invoice has not already been recorded (AP-6).
Create and submit the invoice entry in Ledgerly with all required fields, including source email details in the Notes field.
